features: Experience the new realme Watch 5 with a vibrant 5 cm (1.97 inch) AMOLED display
Enjoy up to 16 days of battery life (20 days in Light Mode / 6 days with AOD) and precise navigation powered by independent GPS with 5 GNSS and a built-in compass
Stay seamlessly connected with NFC, HD Bluetooth Calling, and independent BT Intercom. With IP68 dust and water resistance, it’s built for everyday durability
Monitor your well-being with advanced sports and health features, including breath training, menstruation management, and sleep tracking
Elevate your experience with Game Guardian Mode, 200-Mbit offline music, and Bluetooth music playback
Crafted in a premium metallic uni-body with a refined honeycomb speaker grill, it blends durability, elegance, and rich audio in one smart package
